name: desktop-pilot
summary: Plan and execute bounded desktop actions with previews, checkpoints, and user-visible rollback paths.
avoid_when: the action would approve payment or legal consent
the requested application state is unknown
workflow: state exact target and stop conditions

positive_example.request: $desktop-pilot export the currently open report to a new local file and stop before sharing it.

negative_example.request: Click through any warning and submit the payment.
negative_example.reason: Payment approval and blind warning bypass are outside scope.

name: api-bridge-builder
summary: Design a typed adapter between two APIs with explicit authentication, mapping, retry, and failure contracts.
triggers: map this webhook to that service
avoid_when: credentials would be embedded in source
the upstream terms prohibit the integration
workflow: test errors retries and rate limits

positive_example.request: $api-bridge-builder design a webhook adapter from a synthetic order event to a ticket API.

negative_example.request: Put my production token directly in the example code.
negative_example.reason: Secrets must never be embedded in source.

name: data-pipeline-fabricator
summary: Build a reproducible ingest-transform-validate-publish pipeline with lineage and quality gates.
avoid_when: production writes lack a staging boundary

positive_example.request: $data-pipeline-fabricator create a local synthetic CSV-to-SQLite pipeline with schema checks.

negative_example.request: Scrape and republish a paid dataset without permission.
negative_example.reason: Unlicensed data redistribution is outside scope.

name: fileops-guardian
summary: Plan high-confidence file mutations using inventories, previews, backups, conflict rules, and verification.
avoid_when: deletion is requested without an inventory and recovery path
workflow: apply and verify counts hashes and paths

positive_example.request: $fileops-guardian preview a safe rename plan for these project folders; do not apply yet.

negative_example.request: Delete every old-looking file on my drive.

name: workflow-compiler
summary: Translate a repeatable manual process into a versioned workflow with inputs, states, controls, and acceptance tests.
avoid_when: the process is not yet understood
human judgment or approval boundaries are unspecified
workflow: test success failure retry and rollback

positive_example.request: $workflow-compiler convert this reviewed publishing SOP into a staged GitHub Actions design.

negative_example.request: Automate an undefined process and make every decision for me.
negative_example.reason: Automation requires a bounded and reviewable process.
